newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to start regional funding talks in January.
newsitem.headline: Spain to start regional funding talks in January.

text.p: Spanish Treasury Secretary Juan Costa said on Friday the government would meet regional governments in the second week of January to start talks on a financing agreement for the 1998-2001 period.
How finances are faring so far will also be a subject for discussion, Costa said at a seminar on regional financing.

"In the second week of January the government will meet with the autonomous regions to verify that they are meeting their deficit and debt targets, and to discuss a new pact for the 1998-2001 period," he said.
"1997 is a year in which the government will be particularly preoccupied with meeting the lines (set out in the Maastricht treaty) on the deficit and debt," he said.
From 1998 new rules may be established in the European Union on fiscal consolidation and the deficit, and also on who is responsible when requirements are not met, he added.
